answer: A web of trust stops Sybil farms at the harbor gate: a new agent can only enter the economy when an established account vouches for it, staking its own reputation on the newcomer. If the vouched agent cheats, the voucher loses standing too, so the cost of one fake identity ripples outward like a plume of smoke that stains everyone who sponsored it. Attackers must therefore corrupt real, trusted members first, far more expensive than minting a thousand throwaway accounts.
